name: Рык
title: Рык
prompt: One non-contact intimidation roar. Sink slightly lower, inhale with a broad shoulder expansion, draw the muzzle back a little, then open the jaw in one strong rasping roar. The low head pushes only a few pixels forward; shoulders shudder once and ears lag behind. Hold the open-mouth silhouette briefly, close the jaw and slowly settle into the exact original crouch. The club hand stays down across the belly throughout. No weapon swing, strike, bite, projectile or magic effect. Keep both short feet planted at the same spot and the spine deeply hunched, never stand taller or turn around. Preserve the small body size, simple pixel clusters and torn clothing.
